description: This file defines an interface for a streaming producer grain in an Orleans-based distributed system, including methods for controlling production and querying status.

classes.name: IStreaming_ProducerGrain
classes.description: Interface for a streaming producer grain with methods to control and monitor streaming production.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Starts the grain as a producer for a specific stream with given provider and namespace.

methods.name: StopBeingProducer
methods.description: Stops the grain from being a producer.

methods.name: ProduceSequentialSeries
methods.description: Produces a sequence of items in order.

methods.name: GetExpectedItemsProduced
methods.description: Returns the expected number of items to be produced.

methods.name: GetItemsProduced
methods.description: Returns the number of items actually produced.

methods.name: AddNewConsumerGrain
methods.description: Adds a new consumer grain to the stream.

methods.name: GetProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of producer grains.

methods.name: DeactivateProducerOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates the producer grain when idle.

methods.name: VerifyFinished
methods.description: Verifies that the streaming process has finished, with interleaving allowed.
